worldDesignRevision.granite: 128x128 opaque neutral gray river granite albedo. Fine pixel grain and muted mineral veins; no painted boulder, face, outline, perspective or baked shadows. Shared Riverland palette. Geometry supplies volume.
worldDesignRevision.brenCombat: Preserve the reviewed left-profile face and planted boots, exact native dimensions, gear and palette. Sword in right hand moves upper-left, left at contact, then lower-left; no head turn, mirroring or painted effects. Individually correct three strike keyframes.
worldDesignRevision.hudPortraits: 128x128 transparent detailed head portraits of the five party characters, using their approved original concepts. Complete hair, readable eyes and clean facial anatomy, shared palette; separately authored for the compact HUD, not cropped dialogue busts.

combatEffectsRevision.fire: Transparent isolated warm amber fire tongue, fine restrained pixel clusters, bright pale core and soft orange edge, no scenery or floor. Geometry and particles supply the volume.
combatEffectsRevision.smoke: Transparent isolated soft gray smoke puff, clean pixel clusters, no background, flame or scenery. Engine supplies directional light and rising volume.
combatEffectsRevision.energy: Transparent isolated pale cyan and ivory energy streak and spark texture, coherent Riverland pixel palette. Engine supplies arcs, rings and beams.
combatEffectsRevision.ice: Flat opaque seamless pale blue frost and icy crystal albedo, subtle fine pixel facets, even diffuse light. No pavers, terrain, object silhouette or perspective. Used on dimensional ice shards.

overworldRevision.cloudMask: Pearly billowing cloud, transparent exterior, soft pixel edge; original Elyndor concept palette

overworldRevision.interiorFloor: Seamless worn slate flagstones, muted teal and warm grey, fine pixel-art detail
overworldRevision.runeSeal: Transparent circular ivory gold and cyan magic sigil, clear center and margins

Refined dense HD pixel art at consistent fine pixel density for a lush fantasy river village. No large repeating motif.
